errors.text: The predicted sign is opposite to the target result: the hypothesis claims that SRO suppresses lattice conductivity, whereas the target reports an approximately 12% enhancement.
It omits the central ordering-dominated mechanism: reduced lattice distortion and formation of conductive, percolating HfTi/TiZr B2-like SRO pathways.
The cited evidence establishes SRO, phase behavior, or dislocation effects but provides no direct support for the asserted thermal-transport suppression mechanism.

The proposed measurements do not adequately isolate lattice conductivity in metallic alloys; heat capacity plus laser-flash or 3-omega measurements cannot by themselves separate electronic and lattice contributions.
